## Space destinations

Cosmonautics adds a landable Moon dimension. Create Cosmonautics Expansion adds a landable Mars dimension with plains, frostlands and underground caves. Both have planetary records linked to their playable dimensions.

| Destination | What to expect |
| --- | --- |
| Moon | Lunar highlands, maria and chasms |
| Mars | Plains, frostlands and underground caves |

Deep Space is the transit dimension used by orbital ships, not a planetary surface. The base mod's gas giant and ice world records describe celestial bodies, but do not link to landable dimensions.

- [Space destinations](space.destinations.md) The included landing worlds and how the orbital route relates to them.
- [Orbital flight](space.vehicle-transfer.md) Building and flying a physical spacecraft to space.

***

## Getting started

| Destination | Access |
| --- | --- |
| Overworld | The starting world |
| Nether | Light an obsidian portal |
| End | Activate a stronghold's End portal with <ItemLink id="minecraft:ender_eye" /> |
| Moon and Mars | Use the orbital flight system described in [Orbital flight](space.vehicle-transfer.md) |

Terrain changes appear in newly generated areas. Opening this guide does not rebuild existing terrain.

## 太空目的地

Cosmonautics 新增可登陆的月球维度。Create Cosmonautics Expansion 新增可登陆的火星维度，包含平原、冻原与地下洞穴。两个星球都有与可游玩维度相连的行星数据。

| 目的地 | 地貌 |
| --- | --- |
| 月球 | 月球高地、月海与峡谷 |
| 火星 | 平原、冻原与地下洞穴 |

深空是轨道飞船经过的中转维度，并非行星地表。基础模组中的气态巨行星与冰世界数据只描述天体，没有连接到可登陆维度。

- [太空目的地](space.destinations.md) 查看可登陆星球，以及它们与轨道航线的关系。

space.destinations.en_us:
## Landable destinations

Cosmonautics links the Overworld to a landable Moon dimension. Create Cosmonautics Expansion adds a landable Mars dimension. The base release also defines a gas giant and an ice world as celestial bodies, but their planet records do not link to playable surface dimensions. Seeing a planet in the sky or the planetary display is not proof that it has a landing world.

| Destination | Included terrain |
| --- | --- |
| Moon | Lunar highlands, maria and rocky chasms |
| Mars | Plains, frostlands and underground caves |

The Moon and Mars have dimension definitions as well as planet records. Deep Space is a transit dimension for physical spacecraft, not another planetary surface.

- [Dimensions](world.dimensions.md) The pack's landable dimensions and terrain.
- [Orbital flight](space.vehicle-transfer.md) Build and fly a physical spacecraft.

***

## Getting there

Build a physical ship that Sable can assemble as a moving sublevel. Fit a liquid-fuel <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" /> and consult its built-in Ponder lesson for the engine setup. The transition check uses the ship's world Y coordinate. The Overworld planet data sets the transfer height to 20,000, which is a coordinate, not a distance above the launch pad. When an assembled ship with a valid physics handle crosses that boundary, the transition system moves the ship and nearby passengers into Deep Space. The destination planet data links the Moon and Mars dimensions to the orbital universe.

The <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" /> displays the celestial system. It does not select a destination or pilot a landing.

- [Orbital flight](space.vehicle-transfer.md) Rocket construction and the Overworld to Deep Space transition.
- [Space navigation](space.navigation.md) Read the planetary display and distinguish it from a flight control.
space.destinations.zh_cn:
## 可登陆目的地

Cosmonautics将主世界连接到可登陆的月球维度。Create Cosmonautics Expansion新增可登陆的火星维度。基础版本也定义了气态巨行星与冰世界这两个天体，但其行星数据没有连接到可游玩的地表维度。在天空或行星展示中看到某颗行星，并不能证明存在可登陆的世界。

| 目的地 | 已包含地貌 |
| --- | --- |
| 月球 | 月球高地、月海与岩石峡谷 |
| 火星 | 平原、冻原与地下洞穴 |

月球与火星既有维度定义，也有行星数据。深空是物理飞船使用的中转维度，不是另一个行星地表。

- [维度](world.dimensions.md) 查看整合包中的可登陆维度与地貌。
- [轨道飞行](space.vehicle-transfer.md) 建造并驾驶物理飞船。

***

## 前往目的地

建造一艘能由 Sable 组装为移动子空间的物理飞船。安装液体燃料 <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" />，并查看其内置 Ponder 演示，了解推进器的安装与操作。维度转换检查的是飞船的世界坐标 Y。主世界的行星数据将转换高度设为 20,000，这是坐标值，不是相对于发射台的高度。已组装且拥有有效物理句柄的飞船越过此边界时，转换系统会将飞船及附近乘客带入深空。目的地行星数据将月球与火星维度连接到轨道宇宙中。

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" /> 用于展示天体系统，不能选择目的地或自动驾驶着陆。

- [轨道飞行](space.vehicle-transfer.md) 火箭建造，以及主世界至深空的转换。
- [太空导航](space.navigation.md) 查看行星展示，并了解它与飞行控制的区别。

space.vehicle-transfer.en_us:
## Rocket Thruster

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" />

Use <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_crafter" /> to make the liquid-fuel Rocket Thruster. Find the mechanical crafting recipe in the recipe browser. Its Ponder lesson shows the engine and tank arrangement.

***

## Orbital flight

Build a physical craft that Sable can assemble as a moving sublevel, then fit and fuel the Rocket Thruster. Supply Lava, shown by <ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" />, through the fluid system. The bucket represents the fluid, not a consumed crafting ingredient. The engine accepts fluids in its rocket-fuel tag, not arbitrary liquids, and produces thrust on an assembled physical ship. Keep its fuel supply running. Rotation does not directly drive this engine.

The Overworld to space boundary is the ship's world Y coordinate 20,000. It is not measured upward from the launch site. Crossing it with an assembled, physics-ready ship transfers the craft and nearby passengers into Deep Space. This is an orbital flight transition, not a direct jump from a Rocket Thruster to the Moon. The Moon and Mars are separate linked dimensions in the planetary system.

Do not treat a sky rendering change alone as proof that the ship entered another dimension.

- [Space destinations](space.destinations.md) Landable worlds and the planetary records.
- [Space life support](space.life-support.md) Breathing and gravity inside an intact spacecraft compartment.
- [Space navigation](space.navigation.md) Use the planetary overview without mistaking it for autopilot.

***

## Surface entry

In Deep Space, approaching within the current linked planet's transfer boundary brings the ship back into its surface dimension. For the Overworld, Moon and Mars, that boundary is 20,000 blocks from the planetary surface. The return places the ship at world Y 19,000, not on the ground. This is dimension entry, not touchdown or automatic landing.

Slow descent before world Y 2,500. Downward ship speeds above 60 blocks per second cause heating between Y 1,000 and Y 2,500, and stronger heating can damage nearby passengers.
space.vehicle-transfer.zh_cn:
## 火箭推进器

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" />

使用 <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_crafter" />制作液体燃料火箭推进器。在配方浏览器中查看机械合成配方。推进器的 Ponder 演示展示推进器与储罐的布置。

***

## 轨道飞行

建造一艘能由 Sable 组装为移动子空间的物理飞船，然后安装火箭推进器并为其供油。通过流体系统供应熔岩，<ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /> 表示所需流体，而不是会被消耗的合成材料。推进器只接受火箭燃料标签中的流体，不接受任意液体。它在组装后的物理飞船上产生推力，需保持燃料供应。旋转动力不会直接驱动此推进器。

主世界进入太空的边界是飞船世界坐标 Y 超过 20,000。这不是从发射台向上计算的距离。已组装且准备好物理模拟的飞船越过此边界时，飞船及其附近乘客会被转移到深空。这是进入轨道的飞行转换，不是火箭推进器直接将玩家送到月球。月球与火星是行星系统中的独立连接维度。

不要仅凭天空画面变化就判断飞船已进入其他维度。

- [太空目的地](space.destinations.md) 可登陆世界与行星数据。
- [太空生命支持](space.life-support.md) 完好飞船舱室中的呼吸与重力。
- [太空导航](space.navigation.md) 使用行星总览，不要将其误认为自动驾驶。

***

## 进入地表维度

在深空中，靠近当前所环绕且连接到地表维度的行星，越过转换边界后，飞船会进入该行星的地表维度。主世界、月球与火星的边界距行星表面 20,000 格。返回时飞船位于世界坐标 Y 19,000，而不是地面。这是维度转换，不是落地或自动着陆。

请在世界坐标 Y 2,500 之前减慢下降速度。飞船在 Y 1,000 至 Y 2,500 之间以超过每秒 60 格的速度下降时会发热，更强的热量可能伤害附近乘客。

space.life-support.en_us:
## Breathing in space

The Space Helmet has no crafting recipe. A craftable breathing setup uses <ItemLink id="create:copper_diving_helmet" /> with a charged <ItemLink id="create:copper_backtank" /> in the head and chest slots. Charge the backtank before wearing it, using its Ponder instructions. A charged <ItemLink id="create:netherite_backtank" /> is another air source. The Jetpack supplies air from fuel instead of stored compressed air.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_diving_helmet" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_backtank" />

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" />
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:jetpack" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" />

A Space Helmet allows breathing in space when paired with a pressurized air source. The Cosmonautics Jetpack is a pressurized source as well as a powered flying chestplate. Wear the helmet in the head slot and the Jetpack in the chest slot. The Jetpack supplies pressurized air by slowly consuming its fuel. Its systems also need to be enabled for personal flight.

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/jetpack" />

The Jetpack holds Lava. Its tooltip describes refilling with a <ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /> and filling beneath a <ItemLink id="create:spout" />. Use <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_jetpack" /> to toggle personal flight. The mod default is G. Disable flight when it is not needed to conserve fuel, without disabling the pressurized air supply.

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:jetpack" />

***

## Sealed spacecraft rooms

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />
  <ItemIcon id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" />
  <ItemIcon id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />

Use Deep Seas compartment tools to make an intact, sealed room inside a Sable ship. The Electrolyzer needs water and Forge Energy to make oxygen. Connect that oxygen supply to an Oxygen Diffuser inside the sealed room. The diffuser needs oxygen in its tank and a redstone signal. Deep Air restores breathing for entities in that sealed, unbreached, oxygenated compartment. It does not make oxygen or seal the hull.

<ItemLink id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:oxygen_diffuser" />

To restore gravity in that compartment, place a Gravity Generator within it, provide Forge Energy and give it a neighboring redstone signal. It is active when it is inside a Sable sublevel and both its signal and energy conditions are met. Oxygen supplies breathing. Gravity requires the separate active Gravity Generator, but does not require an oxygen supply.

<ItemLink id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />

<Recipe id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />


Deep Air reads sealed compartments and oxygen diffuser state from Deep Seas. Keep the compartment unbreached and the oxygen supply running. Ponder lessons for the Electrolyzer and Oxygen Diffuser show their power, oxygen and redstone requirements.

- [Orbital flight](space.vehicle-transfer.md) Build and fly the physical spacecraft.
- [Space destinations](space.destinations.md) Moon and Mars destination information.

***

## Personal movement

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:copper_leg_thrusters" />
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:copper_anchor_boots" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:copper_leg_thrusters" /> use pressurized air for flight and inertial damping. Toggle damping with <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_dampeners" />. The mod default is Z.

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/copper_leg_thrusters" />

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:copper_anchor_boots" /> help keep you grounded near a supporting floor. They do not create gravity throughout a room and do not ground an actively flying player.

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/copper_anchor_boots" />
space.life-support.zh_cn:
## 太空呼吸

航天头盔没有合成配方。可合成的呼吸装备为 <ItemLink id="create:copper_diving_helmet" /> 与已充气的 <ItemLink id="create:copper_backtank" />，分别穿在头部与胸部装备栏。穿戴前按背罐的 Ponder 说明充气。已充气的 <ItemLink id="create:netherite_backtank" /> 也是气源。喷气背包则消耗燃料供气，不是储存压缩空气。

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_diving_helmet" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_backtank" />

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" />
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:jetpack" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" />

航天头盔需要搭配加压气源才能在太空中呼吸。Cosmonautics 喷气背包既是加压气源，也是需要燃料的飞行胸甲。将头盔穿在头部装备栏，将喷气背包穿在胸部装备栏。喷气背包会缓慢消耗燃料来持续供气。启用喷气背包系统后才能进行个人飞行。

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/jetpack" />

喷气背包使用熔岩作为燃料。物品提示说明可用 <ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /> 补充，也可使用 <ItemLink id="create:spout" />。使用 <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_jetpack" /> 切换个人飞行功能。模组默认按键为 G。不需要飞行时关闭此功能可节省燃料，不会关闭加压供气。

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:jetpack" />

***

## 密封飞船舱室

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />
  <ItemIcon id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" />
  <ItemIcon id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />

使用 Deep Seas 舱室工具，在 Sable 飞船内部建造完好密封的房间。电解器需要水与 Forge Energy 才能制氧。将氧气供给连接到密封房间内的氧气扩散器。扩散器的储罐必须有氧气，并且方块要接收红石信号。Deep Air 会让密封、未破损且充满氧气的舱室中的实体恢复呼吸。它不会生成氧气，也不会修补船体。

<ItemLink id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:oxygen_diffuser" />

若要恢复该舱室中的重力，请在舱室内放置重力发生器，为其提供 Forge Energy，并在旁边提供红石信号。仅在它位于 Sable 子空间且同时满足信号与能量条件时才将其视为已启动。供氧用于呼吸。重力需要单独启动的重力发生器，但不需要氧气供应。

<ItemLink id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />

<Recipe id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />


Deep Air 会读取 Deep Seas 的密封舱室与氧气扩散器状态。保持舱室完好，并持续供氧。电解器与氧气扩散器的 Ponder 演示会说明供能、氧气和红石信号要求。

- [轨道飞行](space.vehicle-transfer.md) 建造并驾驶物理飞船。
- [太空目的地](space.destinations.md) 查看月球与火星目的地。

space.navigation.en_us:
## Planetary overview

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" />
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:sputnik" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" />

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" />

Place the Hologram Table for an adjustable scale display of the universe. Short-click its configuration points to change the display scale. Use the display as an overview of the celestial system, not as a destination selector or automatic piloting control.

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:sputnik" />

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:sputnik" />

The Sputnik Probe is a persistent chunk loader and reports biome colors. Its description mentions ComputerCraft cartography integration, but that integration is not a route control.

The base Cosmonautics planet records include the Overworld, Moon, Mars, gas giant and ice world. The separate Mars dimension comes from Create Cosmonautics Expansion. The off-world surfaces linked by these records are the Moon and Mars.

- [Space destinations](space.destinations.md) Identify the included landable worlds.
- [Orbital flight](space.vehicle-transfer.md) Read the physical ship transfer boundary.

***

## Helmet display

In Deep Space, <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" /> provides an orbital display. Toggle its alignment helper with <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_alignment" />. The mod default is Y. This changes the display, not the ship's steering.
space.navigation.zh_cn:
## 行星总览

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" />
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:sputnik" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" />

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" />

放置全息桌，即可按不同缩放比例查看宇宙。短按桌面上的配置点可以调整显示比例。它适合作为天体总览，不是目的地选择器，也不是自动驾驶控制器。

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:sputnik" />

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:sputnik" />

Sputnik Probe 是一个持续运行的区块加载器，也会报告生物群系颜色。物品说明提及与 ComputerCraft 的制图集成，但这项集成不是航线控制。

基础 Cosmonautics 行星数据包括主世界、月球、火星、气态巨行星与冰世界。独立的火星维度由 Create Cosmonautics Expansion 提供。在这些天体中，连接到可登陆地表的维度只有月球与火星。

- [太空目的地](space.destinations.md) 查看已包含的可登陆世界。
- [轨道飞行](space.vehicle-transfer.md) 查看物理飞船的转换边界。

***

## 头盔显示

在深空中，<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" /> 提供轨道显示。使用 <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_alignment" /> 切换对齐辅助，模组默认按键为 Y。该功能只改变显示，不会控制飞船转向。
